goal: Low-bandwidth printable / offline kit in frontend/src/components/imperial/print/ and mobile/lib/.
summary: Implemented comprehensive low-bandwidth printable student handouts and offline exploration kit across web and mobile. Built backend service backend/services/offline_kit_service.py and Pydantic schemas in backend/apischemas/offline_kit.py providing structured station bundles with verified primary source excerpts within rights (ĐNTL, Hội Điển Sự Lệ, Nhất Thống Chí), authentic 2D rubbings from ban-duc-noi/ with print-optimized contrast CSS filters, scannable QR verification anchors, 100% paper-achievable offline inspection tasks, and verbatim audio guide transcripts eliminating network streaming data. Added GET /api/v1/imperial/offline-kit endpoint and updated relic inspection to support paper_handout and offline_rubbing modes. Enhanced frontend components PrintableFieldworkWorksheet.tsx, PrintWorksheetModal.tsx, LowBandwidthOfflineKit.tsx, and types.ts. Developed mobile Flutter offline kit in mobile/lib/features/offline_kit/ with LowBandwidthKitModel and LowBandwidthKitScreen wired to GoRouter. Rigorously enforced the negative abuse invariant: no AR or smartphone requirement is mandatory to complete learning assignments (100% paper/2D achievable with full 12/12 Rubric and 25 XP eligibility).

invariants_enforced.zero_device_guarantee: 100% of curriculum competencies (S1 Spatial, S2 Temporal, S3 Evidence, S4 Argument) and inspection tasks are achievable using only paper, pencil, and 2D rubbings.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_no_ar_mandatory: No AR, WebXR, camera permission, or smartphone hardware is mandatory to complete learning assignments or relic inspections. Denied camera or paper handout submissions receive identical full credit (+25 XP, equivalent_learning_completed=True) without penalty.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_equity_enforcement: Any system configuration or assessor attempting to penalize students for lacking AR or camera permissions strictly raises an equity violation (EQUITY_VIOLATION_AR_MANDATORY, HTTP 400).
invariants_enforced.source_excerpts_within_rights: All primary source citations are attributed to authentic royal historical works (Quốc Sử Quán triều Nguyễn, HMCC) with open educational licensing (CC BY 4.0 / Educational Fair Use).
invariants_enforced.high_contrast_2d_rubbings: Rubbing assets from ban-duc-noi/ are validated on disk with cryptographic SHA-256 integrity hashes and print CSS filters (contrast(160%) grayscale(100%)) to ensure crisp legibility on monochrome school printers.
invariants_enforced.zero_streaming_audio_transcripts: Audio guide transcripts are provided verbatim as printable/readable text, allowing offline students to access full historical narrations with 0 MB data consumption.
invariants_enforced.scannable_qr_codes: Each printable station includes a direct QR code linking to digital records and orthogonal aerial maps for optional follow-up when connectivity is available.

changes.description: Created Pydantic schemas for OfflinePrimarySourceItem, OfflineRubbingAsset, OfflineInspectionTask, OfflineAudioTranscript, OfflineKitStation, and LowBandwidthOfflineKitResponse.
Implemented domain service for building standard and comprehensive offline kit bundles, mapping authentic rubbings and audio transcripts, and validating submission fairness.
Extended inspection_mode regex pattern to support paper_handout and offline_rubbing modes, and device_tier to support paper_only and none.
Added GET /api/v1/imperial/offline-kit endpoint returning server-authoritative low-bandwidth offline kit bundles.
Updated route inventory to register the new GET /api/v1/imperial/offline-kit endpoint (531 total routes).
Regenerated OpenAPI snapshot fixture locking the new endpoint contract byte-for-byte.
Extended PrintableStation and WorksheetPrintConfig with OfflineRubbingItem, OfflineInspectionTaskItem, AudioGuideTranscriptItem, and toggle options.
Attached authentic 2D rubbings, paper-executable offline tasks, and audio guide transcripts to all 16 printable stations.

Rendered 100% offline & zero AR guarantee banner, high-contrast 2D rubbings, paper inspection tasks with checkpoints and sketch area, verbatim audio transcripts, and bibliographic rights attributions.
Added customization toggles for 2D rubbings, offline tasks, verbatim transcripts, and high-contrast filter mode.
Created complete standalone offline kit overview component with station preview, JSON bundle exporter, and printable worksheet launcher.
Exported LowBandwidthOfflineKit component and updated types.
Added unit tests verifying high-contrast 2D rubbings, verbatim audio transcripts, offline inspection tasks, and negative abuse zero-AR invariant.
Created Flutter data models for LowBandwidthKitModel, OfflineKitStationModel, OfflineRubbingAsset, OfflineInspectionTask, and OfflineAudioTranscript.
Implemented mobile Flutter screen for offline kit exploration with 2D rubbings, audio transcripts, and offline paper inspection completion action (+25 XP).
Created Flutter unit test suite verifying model parsing, authentic default data, and zero AR/smartphone requirement invariant.
Created 9-test pytest suite verifying offline kit data, API endpoint, disk rubbing assets, paper_handout/offline_rubbing inspection completion, negative abuse equity defense, and component contracts.
